scope: JRA and NAR, all actually readable archived bet types; absent market is missing, never a loss
stake: 100 yen per selected ticket, max 3 tickets for odds bands and EV; fixed top-rank ranges also tested
conditions: course direction and inner/outer when explicitly available
selection: Discovery only. No test period chosen after ranking ROI. Multiplicity-adjusted daily-block profit tests; confirmation and audit both must exceed 100 percent. High payout concentration and removing largest payout are reported.
pre_start_limit: Final odds are ex-post information, not a tradable timestamp backtest. The 5% return reduction is a stress test, not a proof of pre-start profitability.
settlement: Actual official payouts including stake; cancellations and dead heat require dedicated handling and are excluded with counts. Refunds never treated as losses.
market_consistency: Normalized inverse win odds and Plackett-Luce used only as a comparison model, never asserted true probabilities.
